description: Full-window evaluation dataset for Rainshadow: an invented two-region world and one account's use of the app from 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2026 (the fixture's scripted history continued to the end of 2026), with the daily air-quality forecast for one place, a forecast issuance for another every other Monday, and the advisories for the zones the account does not save. Synthetic; separate from the smoke fixture (fixtures/minimal.json).

sources.description: Generated by dev/dataset.cjs: the scripted history of dev/history.cjs and dev/build-fixture.cjs (watches, alert threads, places, preferences, the three detailed days), a scripted continuation to 31 December 2026, and seeded steady records (daily air-quality forecasts for Marrowby, fortnightly Quillmere issuances, advisories for unsaved zones), all applied through the App's own events and tools. Forecast numbers come from closed-form toy models with seeded weather systems; no observed weather, no real place, source or person; nothing collected.

generation.method: scripted history plus seeded steady records, replayed through the App business functions (mulberry32 generator for the steady records)

transformations: None: seed.json is the App state exactly as the replay leaves it, written as compact JSON (sha256 e1f2d87f6d9c8a603a44f7a664808fe719dda4fac87c2cb817917973d9ec0cfa).

review.notes: Automated checks (seed rules after every step, the state schema at the end, the scripted watch outcomes, dev/coverage.cjs, tests/dataset.integration.cjs) do not replace human review of realism: forecast numbers, alert wording, the account's two years, and that every place, source and person is fictional.
